title: Build-A-Pet
brief: Time to design your own kind of thing with a class! A class is a blueprint, and each pet you make from it is an object. The __init__ is done for you, so finish the speak() method, then create a Pet object and make it talk. Run it, then press Check Project!
steps: The Pet class already stores a name and a sound in __init__ (done for you).
Finish the speak() method so it prints, for example: Buddy says Woof!
The program asks the user to name their pet.
Make a Pet called my_pet with that name and the sound "Woof", then call my_pet.speak().
Run it, name your pet, then press Check Project.
starterCode:
